name: rating
title: Rating
description: UI SDK Rating styled as stars that fill to the score: half stars, averages that fill part of a star, a pointer preview, sizes and 44px stars on touch screens.
docs: `<Rating defaultValue step max deselectable size>` in a `Field` (the label names the radio group), or with `aria-label`. Each star is `icon` (lucide's star by default) drawn twice, an outline in `input-strong` and a filled copy in the warning colour clipped to `--rating-fill`, so `step={0.5}` and a read-only average like 4.2 fill part of a star (from the inline end in right to left). `size` is `sm`, `md` or `lg`; on a coarse pointer each star is a 44px box. `readOnly` with `getValueLabel` shows a score as one image. Children (`RatingItem icon`, or your own) replace the stars. In UI SDK 0.1.0-beta.12 a read-only rating keeps hidden radio buttons inside its image, which axe reports as nested-interactive.
